name: v129_fixed_cold_start_factual_comparison
purpose: Implement the frozen v128 Newton solver and chronological runner, then run one fixed offline factual prediction comparison on resident v127 records.
source: v127/runs/{stable,local_speed_drop}/derived_records.jsonl, original immutable v121 selection and v127 successful reproduction/common-prefix receipts. Do not download raw records.
implementation: Use v128 model.py objective and timing.py schedule unchanged. Verify solver on small synthetic known optima and prevent future-label changes from altering earlier predictions before the single real-data run. No prior, penalty, cutpoint or feature search.
initialization: Verify common135 rows match except scenario source identity. Fit full and h-only once each, clone states for the two suffixes, freeze a separate full-model copy. Report original single-class/n=0 support rather than treating the prior as observed evidence.
panel: Exactly150 factual suffix predictions per scenario,300 total; initialization roots are not scored. No control actions are generated.
updates: Each own-scene original nonempty packet strictly before an issue triggers one cumulative refit per updating model, including all-negative packets. Do not fit18000 terminal packets. Freeze each prediction before reading its label for scoring.
comparators: synchronously updated h-only with same intercept prior
gate: Complete declared coverage, exact shared initialization, valid causal chronology, finite converged fits, and unchanged compute accounting. Fresh Brier <= frozen, hold_only, past_prevalence and clock_zero_risk separately in both scenarios; strictly < frozen in at least one scenario AND strictly < hold_only in at least one scenario. Direct arithmetic signs without performance tolerance. Failure closes this fixed estimator; no window, prior, penalty, feature or threshold sweep.

numerical_solver.method: Deterministic damped Newton using the analytic gradient and Hessian, starting every fit at zero coefficients; solve the positive-definite linear system without a fallback estimator.
numerical_solver.convergence: max(abs(gradient))<=1e-8, tested before any step and after the last permitted step
numerical_solver.line_search: Full Newton step first; Armijo c=0.25 and step halving, at most40 candidate steps per iteration. No post-fit calibration or probability clipping.
numerical_solver.numerical_failure: HOLD, preserve partial prediction trace, no alternate solver/prior or restart with modified settings.

compute_accounting: Record actual initialization/refit counts, Newton steps, line-search evaluations and wall time separately. Never report predictor fitting as zero merely because no controller is trained.
output: Keep complete predictions, causal release traces, coefficients and numerical diagnostics on server; return one compact summary at most16000 bytes.
cost_gate: Complete four days and technical checks. fresh-minus-matched-no_fresh mean<0,stable<=0,shock<0; additionally fresh-minus-same-actor-frozen<=0 in each scenario and at least one<0. Report no_fresh-minus-frozen to distinguish baseline drift. Early and tail windows are descriptive, not new gates.
decision: On technical/numerical failure retain partial evidence and HOLD. If the fixed Brier gate fails, close this estimator without tuning or resampling. A pass only permits deciding the next research step; no automatic control experiment or independent-confirmation claim.
